cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology for missing my birthday may be accepted in exchange for first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can Mum have Christmas Day? She's expecting me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's claim is approved. I will permit Boxing Day in return for telling her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you actually stop being hurt instead of just telling her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Genuine forgiveness is authorized for a stay through New Year. You may deduct one day if you offer to wash up without being asked.

reason: Make each emotional counteroffer an approved tier, with B request for sincerity causing a concrete renegotiation of presence and voluntary help.
